message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: In Guizhou province, defendant Jiang used a "meeting" (association) to attract public deposits, i.e., illegal fundraising, violating financial management regulations, disrupting financial order. He collected membership fees from members (red and black groups) with interest, essentially a form of illegal public deposit collection. This is classic "非法吸收公众存款" (illegal collection of public deposits). The description matches many previous examples where the answer is "非法吸收公众存款". Also possibly "非法集资" but the official term used in Chinese criminal law is "非法吸收公众存款罪". So the charge: 非法吸收公众存款.

Check if any other charges apply: He used the funds to pay other debts, but that's part of the illegal deposit scheme. No other crimes like fraud? He promised interest, but the core is illegal public deposit. So single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款<eoa>
